sources.shared_checkpoint_memory: max measured per-path idle, one residency; independent measured path-specific s0; no inferred capability

plan.high_rate_rule: (previous empirical g + 1.2) / frozen s0 seconds; 1.2 is original 2.2x high-load minus g(1), fixed paired offered rate for previous and new count
plan.g_point_rule: g_new = unchanged g_previous * median of three paired within-window throughput(new)/throughput(previous) ratios at matched rate and seed

sequential_termination.memory: measured safe residency plus minimum admitted background cover exceeds every affected frozen budget; retain measured raw count
sequential_termination.no_repeatable_positive_increment: all three full, capacity-pressured matched pairs have throughput(new)<=throughput(previous); a mixed-sign result is inconclusive and cannot stop the frontier
sequential_termination.low_load_unstable: all three lower-load full windows unstable or repeatable count-specific load/runtime failure; high-load overload alone never excludes a count
sequential_termination.higher_counts_after_true_terminal: terminal-evidenced, not artificial missing; never fill their g/M tables

plan.primary_task_rule: historical measured scaling task if present; otherwise largest summed service demand in frozen 11A capacity witnesses
plan.other_task_probe: 3 serial samples per replica on every other admitted path; separate from capacity window
plan.capacity_scope: same frozen family scalar / representative-path transfer convention; probes do not establish mixed-task capacity

protective_stop.action: Stop arrivals, bounded drain, preserve raw unstable outcome; skip remaining repetitions of that exact condition. No higher budgets, retries or loads.

plan.history_hardware_note: Historical Module7 scaling may originate on a different GPU UUID; keep old points immutable; every new adjacent pair measured on current frozen Module10 hardware.

utility_definition.formula: U = wQ*Q_norm - wT*T_norm - wL*L_norm - wP*P_norm - wM*M_norm

quality.reason: Accuracy, WER and OCR metrics have no direction-consistent cross-task cardinal utility calibration. wQ=0 disables quality reward; no missing scores filled.

utility_definition.L_norm: sum(lambda_k/sum(lambda) * mean_E2E_k/ref_ms_k); offered weights frozen, never reweighted by completions
utility_definition.P_norm: sum(lambda_k/sum(lambda) * P95_E2E_k/ref_ms_k); separate raw pooled-request P95 reported
utility_definition.T_norm: 1 - min(1, completed/offered, completed_in_window/(fixed_offered_QPS*planned_window_seconds)); stopped measurement retains planned denominator. Positive sustained queue growth invalidates U via hard stability constraint. Drain cannot erase throughput loss.
utility_definition.M_norm: max(safe_factor*postwarm_idle_mean, safe_factor*postmeasurement_idle_mean)/frozen_budget; prediction uses reconciled safe table/budget
hard_constraints: system and worker not unstable; recoverable only if original recovery confirmed and no sustained growth
utility_definition.unstable_policy: U=null, eligible=false. Completed-only latency components retained as CENSORED diagnostic, never sortable. No artificial finite utility for unstable plans.
utility_definition.primary_tie_rule: maximize predicted U, then smaller safe memory, then canonical JSON identity
utility_definition.positive_gain_rule: delta_U > 0.01; positive means improvement against an explicit feasible same-workload comparator, never absolute U (cost-only U<=0)
utility_definition.holdout_support_rule: At least 3 distinct independent matched workload/deployment-group contrasts across >=2 model combinations, >=80% ranking agreement, zero high-confidence reversals, >=80% stress-interval coverage. Module19 never independent validation.
utility_definition.selection_uncertainty: Nominal maximum U among nominal rho<1 candidates; operational rho>0.8 and stress-unstable candidates remain visible as conditional, not certified stable or deployment-ready.

utility_reference.reference_rule: Median admitted standalone service ms across full reconciled Heavy pool; same physical reference for mean and P95, not a tail SLO or measured P95 reference. Independent of Module19 outcome and Proposed labels.
development_groups: Module14F: profiles (g/M measured here cannot independently validate same profiles)
Module19: ALL cases including all negative and failed results
retrospective_holdout_groups: Module16: entire full-pool six-task deployment combination and LOW/MID workloads, all repetitions together
utility_reference.holdout_limits: Retrospective archival holdout, already reported publicly within project; no fitting to these observations, no blind/prospective claim. Only one deployment per offered workload exists: independent matched deployment-ranking sample count is zero. Module17 own holdout supports only its original scope.

generator.method: MILP linear normalized-service + safe-memory seeds; target G fractions [free,0,.01,.05,.2,.5,1], rho caps [.8,.95]; retain frozen historical candidates; generation weights main plus low/high memory; no phase restrictions
generator.completeness: Heuristic candidate set; not an exhaustive utility optimum. Same deployment may host multiple Specialists; measured counts unmodified.

predictor.method: 120-second deterministic-periodic FIFO fluid-service replay with family round robin; path s0 * replicas/g(count). Constant service captures queue collisions; does not claim sample-tail model or transferable interference calibration.
predictor.stress_interpretation: Engineering scenarios, NOT fitted corrections, confidence intervals or measured bounds; no global Module17 transfer.
predictor.calibration: No parameter fit to Module19 or holdout. Frozen independent standalone s0/g/M only. Relative ranking hypothesis tested separately.
predictor.structural_limit: Constant service omits sample variability and cross-process interference; P95 and capacity carry high uncertainty.

utility_reference.three_phase_test: For each pool/budget/target evaluate every QPS. Natural LOW reuses G with no target S; MID deploys target S with G fraction zero; HIGH mixed. Require LOW beats feasible S-only, MID beats feasible G-only, HIGH beats best feasible pure route by >0.01; all nominal constraints pass. Strict increasing LOW<MID<HIGH; optional stress robustness separate.
